book_title: 小蓝本高中卷4 均值不等式与柯西不等式
stem_md: 已知 $x, y, z \in \mathbf{R}_{+} \cup \{0\}$, 且 $x + y + z = 2$. 证明: $x^{2} y^{2} + y^{2} z^{2} + z^{2} x^{2} + xyz \leqslant 1$, 并求上式取等号时, $x, y, z$ 的值.
solution_md:
证明 注意到
$$
x^{2} y^{2} + y^{2} z^{2} + z^{2} x^{2} + xyz
$$
$$
= \frac{1}{2}\left(2 x^{2} y^{2} + 2 y^{2} z^{2} + 2 z^{2} x^{2} + 2 xyz\right)
$$
$$
= \frac{1}{2}\left(xy \cdot 2xy + yz \cdot 2yz + zx \cdot 2zx + 2xyz\right)
$$
$$
\leqslant \frac{1}{2}\left[xy(x^{2} + y^{2}) + yz(y^{2} + z^{2}) + zx(z^{2} + x^{2}) + 2xyz\right]
$$
$$
= \frac{1}{4}\left[(xy + yz + zx)(x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2}) - xyz^{2} - yzx^{2} - zxy^{2} + 2xyz\right]
$$
$$
= \frac{1}{16}(x + y + z)^{4} = 1.
$$
由式①知, 当 $x = y = z$ 或 $x = y$, $z = x$ 或 $x = z$, $y = x$ 时, 式②取等号.
运用常见不等式
$$
\alpha \beta \leqslant \left(\frac{\alpha + \beta}{2}\right)^{2} \quad (\alpha, \beta \in \mathbf{R}).
$$
令 $\alpha = 2xy + 2yz + 2zx$, $\beta = x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2}$. 则
$$
\begin{aligned}
& \frac{1}{2}(2xy + 2yz + 2zx)(x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2}) - xyz(x + y + z - 2) \\
& = \frac{1}{4}\left(2xy + 2yz + 2zx\right)\left(x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2}\right) - xyz(x + y + z - 2) \\
& = \frac{1}{16}(x + y + z)^{4} = 1.
\end{aligned}
$$
结合式②得
$$
x^{2} y^{2} + y^{2} z^{2} + z^{2} x^{2} + xyz \leqslant 1.
$$
由式③取等号的条件知, 当
$$
\alpha = \beta \Leftrightarrow 2xy + 2yz + 2zx = x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2}
$$
时, 式④等号成立.
故 $(x, y, z) = (1, 1, 0)$ 或 $(1, 0, 1)$ 或 $(0, 1, 1)$.
